practice_description.medium: Software infrastructure, web protocols, API, marketplace
practice_description.practice_summary: Consent infrastructure for AI training data. Evolved from HaveIBeenTrained.com (artist opt-out search engine for LAION-5B) to Source.Plus (curated marketplace for consented, non-infringing AI training data). Created the ai.txt protocol as an AI-era successor to robots.txt.
practice_description.methodology: Spawning builds tools at the intersection of art, technology, and rights management. The approach is layered: first establish opt-out (HaveIBeenTrained), then create interoperable standards (ai.txt protocol), then build opt-in marketplace (Source.Plus). Partners with major AI developers (Stability AI, Hugging Face) to honor Do Not Train registries. Hosts all images on Source.Plus directly to protect cultural institutions from scraping. Employs moderators for data verification.

relevance_to_sense_room.relevance_summary: Spawning provides the consent and provenance infrastructure that any ethical graph-curated generative exhibition requires. If A(DAI) uses AI-processed creative material, Spawning's tools and protocols represent the standard for ensuring consented, traceable data sourcing.
relevance_to_sense_room.art_as_substrate: Indirectly -- Spawning does not produce art itself, but it provides the substrate infrastructure (consent verification, provenance tracking, data curation) that enables art-as-substrate to function ethically. Source.Plus curates the raw material (training data) from which generative art is made.
relevance_to_sense_room.relational_composition: Yes, at an infrastructure level. Spawning's system maps relationships between data creators, datasets, AI models, and outputs. The ai.txt protocol creates a relational web of permissions across the internet. Source.Plus mediates relationships between rights holders and AI developers.
relevance_to_sense_room.self_recomposing: Yes -- the consent layer is dynamic. Artists can change their opt-in/opt-out status at any time via ai.txt, and the system responds in real time when datasets are accessed. Source.Plus evolves as new collections are curated and new rights holders join.

works.title: HaveIBeenTrained.com
works.description: Search engine allowing artists to find their work in the LAION-5B dataset (5.8 billion images) used to train Stable Diffusion and Midjourney, and opt out. Over 1 billion artworks opted out by April 2023. Partnered with Shutterstock and ArtStation.
works.relevance: First widely adopted tool for artist agency over AI training data. Demonstrated that consent infrastructure is technically feasible at scale and that artists would use it.

works.title: ai.txt Protocol
works.description: Website-level protocol allowing site owners to set permissions for AI data mining, addressing limitations of robots.txt. Checked when dataset links are used to download content, enabling real-time permission adjustments. WordPress plugin available. Adopted by Hugging Face and Stability AI.
works.relevance: Open protocol that creates a machine-readable consent layer across the web. Directly relevant to any AI system that ingests web content -- establishes the standard for consented data use.

works.title: Source.Plus
works.description: Marketplace for searching, curating, and downloading non-infringing media collections for AI training. Hosts all content directly (not link-based scraping). Includes public domain datasets and premium licensed collections from rights holders. Content moderation and provenance verification built in.
works.relevance: Evolution from opt-out to opt-in: a marketplace where consented, high-quality training data can be sourced. Models how data commons can be commercially viable while respecting creator rights.

protocol_art_resonance.protocol_art_summary: Spawning originated from an art practice (Holly Herndon and Mat Dryhurst's work with Spawn and Holly+) and extends protocol art to industry scale. The consent layer IS the artwork at a systemic level -- designing the rules, standards, and infrastructure through which AI training data flows. The ai.txt protocol is a creative intervention in internet infrastructure.
protocol_art_resonance.system_designed: HaveIBeenTrained (opt-out search engine and registry); ai.txt protocol (web standard for AI permissions); Do Not Train registry (honored by Stability AI and Hugging Face); Source.Plus (consented training data marketplace); Spawning API and open-source Python package for consent management; WordPress plugin for ai.txt implementation.

commons_orientation.licence_model: Hybrid -- open-source API and Python packages as public goods; ai.txt is an open protocol; Source.Plus operates as a commercial marketplace with premium licensed collections alongside public domain datasets.
commons_orientation.commons_summary: Spawning explicitly positions itself as building 'the consent layer for AI' as infrastructure that benefits the entire ecosystem. HaveIBeenTrained and ai.txt are public goods. Source.Plus creates a viable economic model for commons -- artists can monetize consented use of their work. The seed funding framing emphasized 'opt-out and opt-in standards as a public good.' Opposes both unconsented extraction and total prohibition.

governance_model.governance_detail: Spawning operates as a venture-backed startup ($3M seed from True Ventures, Seed Club Ventures, and angel investors including Balaji Srinivasan). Decision-making is corporate, but the tools it builds enable decentralized governance by creators (individual opt-in/opt-out via ai.txt, collective governance via registries). Source.Plus includes content moderation with remediation features for flagging infringing works.

consent_and_authorship.consent_approach: Consent is the entire mission. Spawning provides multi-layered consent tools: individual (HaveIBeenTrained opt-out), site-level (ai.txt protocol), platform-level (partnerships with Stability AI, Hugging Face), and market-level (Source.Plus licensed collections). Consent is dynamic -- permissions can be updated in real time.
consent_and_authorship.authorship_model: Platform model -- Spawning does not claim authorship over the data it manages. It creates infrastructure for rights holders to maintain authorship and control. The marketplace model explicitly preserves creator attribution and enables direct monetization.

liveness_and_duration.temporal_detail: The consent layer is a living system that evolves as artists change permissions, new datasets emerge, new AI developers join partnerships, and the regulatory landscape shifts. ai.txt permissions are checked in real time. Source.Plus grows as new collections are curated. The system is designed to be permanent infrastructure.

data_materiality.data_sources: Indexes LAION-5B (5.8 billion images) for opt-out; hosts curated media collections on Source.Plus (images, potentially other modalities); public domain datasets; licensed premium collections from rights holders and cultural institutions.
data_materiality.data_provenance: Data provenance is the core product. Source.Plus verifies ownership and consent status of all hosted content. Content moderation team verifies data ownership. Public domain status is confirmed. Licensed collections have explicit rights agreements. The entire system exists to solve the provenance problem in AI training.

embedding_space_relevance.embedding_summary: Spawning does not directly work with embedding spaces, but its infrastructure determines what data enters the embedding spaces of AI models trained on its curated datasets. By controlling the consent and provenance of training data, Spawning shapes the latent spaces of downstream AI models.
embedding_space_relevance.multimodal: Yes -- HaveIBeenTrained started with images but Spawning's API and ai.txt protocol are media-agnostic, covering text, images, audio, and video. Source.Plus aims to serve multi-modal training data needs.

exhibition_modality.spatial_description: Spawning operates entirely in digital/web space: websites (HaveIBeenTrained, Source.Plus), protocols (ai.txt), APIs, and WordPress plugins. No physical exhibition component, though the infrastructure enables physical exhibitions that use ethically sourced AI-generated content.

interoperability.composability: Very high -- designed as interoperable infrastructure. ai.txt is an open web protocol adoptable by any website. Spawning API is public and has an open-source Python package. Do Not Train registry is honored by multiple AI platforms. WordPress plugin enables one-click implementation. Source.Plus outputs (curated datasets) are designed to feed directly into AI training pipelines.
interoperability.technical_openness: Partially open -- API and Python package are open-source. ai.txt is an open protocol. Source.Plus marketplace has proprietary elements (curation, hosting, moderation). WordPress plugin is open.

technical_approach.stack: Web platform (HaveIBeenTrained search engine, Source.Plus marketplace); ai.txt protocol (plaintext file in website root directory, similar to robots.txt); REST API for consent status queries; open-source Python package; WordPress plugin; content moderation and classification tools; direct media hosting (not link-based); partnerships with Hugging Face and Stability AI for protocol adoption.

network_position.scene_affiliation: AI ethics and policy (influenced EU text and data mining policy); AI training data ecosystem; open-source AI community (Hugging Face partnership); commercial AI (Stability AI, Shutterstock partnerships); digital arts and creator rights; Web3/crypto art community (Seed Club Ventures investor, Noise DAO investor).
network_position.connections: Holly Herndon and Mat Dryhurst (co-founders, originating from their art practice); Holly+ (predecessor project exploring consent and voice AI); Stability AI (Do Not Train partnership); Hugging Face (protocol adoption); Shutterstock and ArtStation (opt-out partnerships); True Ventures and Seed Club Ventures (investors); Interdependence (conceptual framework).

potential_role_in_adai.role_detail: Spawning/Source.Plus could provide the consent and provenance infrastructure A(DAI) needs for any AI-processed creative material in its pipeline. If A(DAI)'s signal processor uses AI to analyze or transform creative content, Spawning's tools ensure consented sourcing. The ai.txt protocol could be adopted by A(DAI) for its own data governance. Source.Plus could be a data source for ethically curated training material. Aligns perfectly with A(DAI)'s commons-first principles.
